name: five-nights-at-church
description: A 3D first-person horror game prototype inspired by FNAF, featuring weeping angels, haloed saints, CCTV monitoring, and church office defenses.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease

author: Antigravity
